records.observed: PNG output uses rsvg-convert; its bytes are stable on one host but not guaranteed across librsvg versions. Text is outlined so layout cannot drift, only anti-aliasing can.
records.decided: The SVG digest is the identity; PNG is a derived frame.
open: Pin a pure-JS rasteriser (resvg-js) and add a PNG golden if a video pipeline needs byte-identical frames.

records.observed: The scorer does not measure baseline-grid rhythm, data-ink ratio, colour-vision-deficiency separation or aesthetic quality. Benchmark text fidelity is a reviewer reading because the host has no OCR. Hyphenation is a heuristic, not Liang patterns. Kerning uses GPOS pair tables only, no GSUB ligatures or complex scripts; Latin-script text only.
records.decided: Declare these in the rubric as not measured rather than score them.
open: Add CVD simulation to the contrast criterion.
Add OCR (tesseract) to the benchmark skill so text fidelity is measured.

records.observed: Shared media plan (computer-media-engineering-services-section PR #5) admits visual.assets[] of { id, role frame|overlay, mediaType image/svg+xml, svg <= 400000 chars self-contained, or identity NI, producer }. media-engineering-services-section PR #1 embeds each asset as a data-URI <image> on a hard-coded 540x960 scene with preserveAspectRatio=meet and rasterises through ffmpeg. All four example infographics pass svgIsSelfContained (74k-123k chars) and a 9:16 asset composites through ffmpeg exactly as composeShotSvg does (checked here).
records.decided: mediaPlanAsset() / `infographic plan-asset` emit exactly the slot shape with no adaptation; they refuse an aspect that differs from the plan's (the renderer would letterbox it silently), always outline text (an SVG inside <image> loads no fonts) and warn when the smallest text would be under 10 px at the render width.
open: Proposal on PR #5: asset declares aspect (or the admit step reads the viewBox) and admission refuses mismatch with plan.aspect; the 540x960 scene in the renderer is hard-coded and ignores plan.aspect 16:9 and render.width.
Proposal on PR #5: producer.spec should carry the spec digest and the identity should be required for inline assets so a renderer can verify bytes.
Proposal: export svgIsSelfContained from the media-plan module so the infographic engine need not restate it (restated copy can drift).
Default render width 360 px makes any infographic text under 8 px; infographics for video need a sparse video spec (fewer words) rather than the poster density; no video-density rubric yet.
Not tested: the full media-plan compile and the renderer end to end (host starved); only the composite step.
records.provenance: read of cmes-pr5 src/media-plan.mjs and mes pr1 apps/previsualize-microdrama.mjs; slot-check script run 2026-10-24
